edges.reason: transfer() delegates the actual token movement to _transfer.
transferFrom() delegates token movement to _transfer.
transferFrom() calls _approve to reduce the spender allowance.
approve() calls _approve to set the allowance.
msg.sender is checked against the bot blacklist inside _transfer.
tx.origin is used in the bot blacklist check, tying transfers to the transaction origin.
_isBlackListedBot mapping gates _transfer execution.
_isExcludedFromLimit controls whether maxTx/maxWallet checks apply.
_isExcludedFromFee decides whether fees are taken in _transfer.
_isExcludedFromFee lookups feed the takeFee decision in _transfer.
_isExcluded determines whether balanceOf reads _tOwned or converts reflections.
_transfer reads balanceOf(address(this)) to size the auto-liquidity swap.
balanceOf converts reflection balances via tokenFromReflection.
_transfer hands control to _tokenTransfer to apply fees and dispatch.
_transfer triggers swapAndLiquify, which performs external ETH transfers and router calls before the transfer completes.
swapAndLiquifyEnabled conditionally enables the auto swap path in _transfer.
_maxTxAmount caps the contract token balance and enforces transfer limits.
_maxWalletSize restricts the recipient balance inside _transfer.
numTokensSellToAddToLiquidity is the threshold that decides whether swapAndLiquify runs.
_tokenTransfer clears all fees via removeAllFee before applying buy/sell fees.
_tokenTransfer loads buy fees via setBuy when the sender is the pair.
_tokenTransfer loads sell fees via setSell when the recipient is the pair.
_tokenTransfer routes non-excluded to non-excluded transfers to _transferStandard.
_tokenTransfer routes non-excluded to excluded transfers to _transferToExcluded.
_tokenTransfer routes excluded to non-excluded transfers to _transferFromExcluded.
_tokenTransfer routes excluded to excluded transfers to _transferBothExcluded.
_transferStandard computes token fee values via _getTValues.
_transferStandard computes reflection values via _getRValues.
_transferStandard obtains the current rate via _getRate.
_transferStandard credits the liquidity fee via _takeLiquidity.
_transferStandard credits the wallet fee via _takeWalletFee.
_transferStandard applies the reflection fee via _reflectFee.
_transferToExcluded computes token values via _getTValues.
_transferToExcluded computes reflection values via _getRValues.
_transferFromExcluded computes token values via _getTValues.
_transferFromExcluded computes reflection values via _getRValues.
_transferBothExcluded computes token values via _getTValues.
_transferBothExcluded computes reflection values via _getRValues.
deliver computes token fee values via _getTValues.
deliver computes reflection values via _getRValues.
deliver accrues _tFeeTotal by the delivered amount.
deliver reduces _rTotal by the computed reflection amount, altering the global rate.
_transferStandard debits and credits _rOwned reflection balances.
_transferFromExcluded debits _tOwned of the excluded sender.
swapAndLiquify calls swapTokensForEth to convert tokens into ETH.
swapAndLiquify calls addLiquidity to re-inject liquidity.
swapAndLiquify performs an external ETH transfer to the marketing address.
swapAndLiquify performs an external ETH transfer to the dev wallet.
swapAndLiquify is wrapped by lockTheSwap which sets the inSwapAndLiquify guard.
swapTokensForEth calls the external Uniswap router swap function.
swapTokensForEth passes block.timestamp as the router deadline, making the call timestamp dependent.
swapTokensForEth approves and targets the uniswapV2Router address.
addLiquidity calls the external Uniswap router addLiquidityETH with ETH value.
addLiquidity uses block.timestamp as the router deadline.
addLiquidity approves and targets the uniswapV2Router address.
constructor derives uniswapV2Pair from uniswapV2Router.factory().createPair.
constructor creates the Uniswap pair for the token.
constructor sets the immutable router instance.
constructor assigns the deployer as owner via _msgSender().
constructor uses _msgSender() to seed the initial owner and initial supply.
onlyOwner compares _owner against _msgSender().
onlyOwner compares _msgSender() to the stored owner.
renounceOwnership is restricted by onlyOwner.
transferOwnership is restricted by onlyOwner.
lock is restricted by onlyOwner.
addBotToBlacklist is restricted by onlyOwner.
removeBotFromBlacklist is restricted by onlyOwner.
excludeFromReward is restricted by onlyOwner.
includeInReward is restricted by onlyOwner.
excludeFromFee is restricted by onlyOwner.
includeInFee is restricted by onlyOwner.
setSellFee is restricted by onlyOwner.
setBuyFee is restricted by onlyOwner.
setMaxTxPercent is restricted by onlyOwner.
_setMaxWalletSizePercent is restricted by onlyOwner.
setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled is restricted by onlyOwner.
lock uses block.timestamp to compute _lockTime, making the lock duration timestamp dependent.
unlock requires block.timestamp > _lockTime, so ownership restoration depends on the timestamp.
unlock requires _previousOwner == msg.sender to restore ownership.
unlock reads _previousOwner to decide who may unlock.
unlock compares block.timestamp against _lockTime.
lock writes _lockTime = block.timestamp + time.
lock sets _owner to address(0) and stores the previous owner, temporarily removing owner control.
lock copies _owner into _previousOwner before clearing ownership.
renounceOwnership writes address(0) into _owner.
transferOwnership overwrites _owner with the new owner.
setSellFee writes the sell fee percentages.
setBuyFee writes the buy fee percentages.
setMaxTxPercent multiplies _tTotal by maxTxPercent and divides by 10**3 to derive _maxTxAmount.
_setMaxWalletSizePercent multiplies _tTotal by a percentage and divides by 10**3.
setMaxTxPercent updates _maxTxAmount.
_setMaxWalletSizePercent updates _maxWalletSize.
The marketing wallet address is the destination of the external ETH transfer.
The dev wallet address is the destination of the external ETH transfer.
_getTValues calls the fee calculation functions (calculateTaxFee and peers).
_getRValues uses currentRate produced by _getRate.
_reflectFee reduces _rTotal by the reflection fee.
_reflectFee adds the token fee to _tFeeTotal.
removeBotFromBlacklist mutates the _blackListedBots array with pop and swap.
addBotToBlacklist pushes the account into _blackListedBots.
addBotToBlacklist flips _isBlackListedBot, granting the owner the power to block transfers.
excludeFromReward flips _isExcluded for the account.
excludeFromReward pushes the account into the _excluded array.
includeInReward removes the account from the _excluded array.
excludeFromFee sets _isExcludedFromFee for the account.
setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled toggles the auto swap flag.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter 'from' defines the token source account processed by _transfer.
Parameter 'to' defines the token destination account processed by _transfer.
Parameter 'amount' is the transfer amount validated and moved by _transfer.
Parameter 'account' is the address written into the blacklist by addBotToBlacklist.
Parameter 'newOwner' becomes the new owner written by transferOwnership.
Parameter 'time' is added to block.timestamp to set the lock deadline in lock.
Local contractTokenBalance governs the swapAndLiquify trigger inside _transfer.
Local path array is the token/WETH route passed to the router in swapTokensForEth.
Parameter 'recipient' is forwarded by the public transfer function into _transfer.
Parameter maxTxPercent scales _tTotal to recompute _maxTxAmount in setMaxTxPercent.
